# Data Inventory

**Last Updated**: 2026-06-10 (auto-generated)

Generated by `python -m yen_gov coverage`. Do not hand-edit. Re-run after every election ingest. Canonical indicator inventory lives in [`datasets/data/variables.csv`](../../datasets/data/variables.csv) and [`datasets/data/datapoints/`](../../datasets/data/datapoints/); this report covers election catalogue and on-disk election coverage. The declared election catalogue lives at [datasets/taxonomy/election_events.json](../../datasets/taxonomy/election_events.json); on-disk election artifacts live under [datasets/elections/](../../datasets/elections/). The Temporal Richness meter (● filled / ○ empty) is explained in [docs/architecture/backend/coverage.md](../architecture/backend/coverage.md).

## Summary

- 404 (state, event) slices on disk across 36 states / 45 cohorts.
- Assembly (AC): 251 slice(s) / 13,775 summary row(s) emitted.
- Parliament (PC): 153 slice(s) / 1,861 summary row(s) emitted.
- 1 slice(s) declared but awaiting upstream publication (`data_status: pending_upstream`).
